## Repair pass on the digest rework: fix _run_git call shapes and bytes decoding… — 2026-07-25 (parent 20f06c021ab3)

Storage model replaced: instead of prepending all entries into a single `TRIE_DIFF.md`, each commit now gets its own immutable file under `triediffs/` named `<utc-timestamp>-<uuid4>.md` (via `_new_digest_filename`), making lexicographic order equal to chronological order. `write_digest` handles creation, same-commit rewrite (via `reuse_file` from the cursor), mtime-ordered retention pruning to `max_entries`, and atomically repoints `TRIE_DIFF.md` as a relative symlink (regular-file fallback). `upsert_digest` is deleted.

Key changes:
- `Diff` config gains `diffs_dir='triediffs'`; `write_path` becomes the symlink target; `max_entries` is now a file-retention cap
- `diff_cmd` routes `--write` through `write_digest` and saves the written filename into the cursor's new `file` field via `save_digest_cursor`
- `PRE_COMMIT_HOOK_BLOCK` now stages both `TRIE_DIFF.md` and `triediffs/`
- `test_write_digest_files_symlink_and_prune` replaces `test_upsert_digest_prepend_replace_trim`
